neighbours.label: the verb ' show' / ' shows' / ' showed' with a study, paper or tutorial as its subject, as opposed to a person showing something and the noun 'show'
fire: Results from the trial show modest gains in reading.
This guide shows how to set up the printer.
Our earlier study showed that sleep helps memory.
This report shows a clear decline in bird numbers.
The data clearly show an increase after 2010.
As this paper shows, small firms grow faster.
The new analysis showed that rates were stable.
This chapter shows how the proof can be simplified.
quiet: Tickets for the talent show go on sale next week.
My uncle shows his horses at the state fair.
Our neighbor showed us the way to the lake.
This reality show has a clear winner every year.
The kids clearly show off in front of guests.
As the waiter showed us in, the band began to play.
The new teacher showed up late on Monday.
This comedy show airs on Saturday night.

notes: Small corpus max (2.88), and the card says 61% is in the echo regime. Neighbouring verbs reached 0.17–0.20 in probes ('explains', 'introduces'), so the verb is not the only way in.
